confirm_intro: Thank you for your booking! Here is your summary. Show the QR code below at the entrance on the day.
vat_exempt: VAT not applicable, art. 293 B CGI
qr_help: Your ticket: show it at the entrance (on your phone or printed).
calendar: The attached file adds the session to your calendar.
refund_full_until: Full refund up to {days} days before the session (booking fee excluded), on request to the organiser.
refund_partial: Refund on request to the organiser, minus {rate} (booking fee excluded).
contact: Any question? Just reply to this email: your message will reach {org}.
soldout_text: Your payment arrived after the booking window had expired, and the session filled up in the meantime. You have been fully refunded (fees included). We're sorry for the inconvenience.
refund_text: {org} has refunded you {amount} for booking {ref}. Depending on your bank, it shows on your account within 5 to 10 days.
cancel_text: Your booking {ref} was cancelled by the organiser.
cancel_refund: You have been refunded {amount}; it shows on your account within 5 to 10 days.
reminder_intro: A quick reminder: your session is in less than 48 hours. Remember your ticket (QR code below).
dispute_text: The buyer of booking {ref} disputed the payment with their bank. Respond to the dispute from your Stripe dashboard (Disputes) before the deadline Stripe shows.
invoice_text: Your ticketing commission {doc} {number} for {period} ({amount} incl. VAT) is available in the Studio, under Payments.
results_intro: Well done, team {team}! Here is your result.
results_thanks: Thanks for playing with {org}. See you soon for a new adventure!
